    char ch = getchar();
    while (ch < 33) ch = getchar();
    while (ch > 33) {
        result = (result * 10) + (ch - '0');
        ch = getchar();
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long i, x, y, n, a = 0, b = 1, p, q, temp, t1, t2;
    x = read_input();
    y = read_input();
    n = read_input();

    for (i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        p = x * i / y;
        q = p + 1;
        temp = (i * (long long)fabs(x * b - a * y));
        t1 = b * (long long)fabs(x * i - y * p);
        t2 = b * (long long)fabs(x * i - y * q);
        if (t1 < temp) {
            a = p;
            b = i;
            temp = t1;
        }
        if (t2 < temp) {
            a = q;
            b = i;
            temp = t2;
        }
    }
    std::cout << a << "/" << b;
}
